stories.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
stories.simple_summary: A tool used by computer security experts to test for weaknesses was accidentally left exposed on the internet. This means hackers could have easily found it and used it to break into computers.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business that stores customer information or payments online, weak security tools floating around increases the risk that someone could hack into your systems. You should make sure your IT support person keeps your business's security up to date.

stories.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
stories.simple_summary: Meta is adding a new feature called Spaces to its AI assistant Muse. This lets the AI create customized mini-apps that work just the way you need them to.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people already using Meta's AI. There's nothing you need to do unless you use Muse and want to try the new Spaces feature.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now
stories.simple_summary: Meta's Muse AI assistant can now build custom mini-apps for you. For example, it could create a shopping hub, a music tracker, or a school dashboard that you interact with right inside the app.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people already using Meta's AI. There's nothing you need to do unless you want to experiment with this new way of organizing information.

stories.title: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
stories.simple_summary: After recent elections, voters rejected almost all proposals to build new data centers. Data centers are huge warehouses that hold computer servers. This could slow down AI companies' ability to build the infrastructure they need.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech executives. It may eventually affect how expensive AI services become, but it won't directly impact you right now.

stories.title: After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years?
stories.simple_summary: Election results suggest that voters rejected proposals to expand data centers. This could make it harder and more expensive for AI companies to grow over the next two years.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies. There's nothing you need to do, though higher costs for AI companies could eventually mean slower AI improvements or higher prices for AI services you use.

stories.title: AI is the new dating dealbreaker
stories.simple_summary: Young people using dating apps are starting to see AI use as a major factor in whether they want to date someone. Some think AI use shows important things about someone's values.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you are dating or advising young people on dating, this won't affect you. It's mostly interesting as a sign of how people now care about AI in their personal decisions.

stories.title: Big Tech lost big in the 2026 election
stories.simple_summary: Voters in recent elections voted against big tech companies, particularly rejecting plans to build more data centers. This suggests the coming years will bring tougher rules for technology companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech executives. You should know that regulations on tech companies may increase, which could eventually affect services you use or their cost.

stories.title: How Akai and Moog are embracing vibe-coded mods
stories.simple_summary: Two music equipment makers, Akai and Moog, decided to let their community of users modify and customize their products. They are sharing the tools people need to do this.
stories.why_it_matters: If you are a musician who likes to tinker with equipment and customize it, this is good news. Most people won't be affected by this.

stories.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
stories.simple_summary: Companies are using more AI, but they are not spending more money on it because prices have dropped and they are being smarter about costs. This surprises investors who expected spending to keep rising.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. It shows that AI is becoming cheaper and more efficient, which is good for you if you use AI services, but there is nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is adding a feature that lets you text shopping requests to Alexa instead of speaking out loud. Alexa can now help you buy items by reading your text descriptions or even looking at photos you send.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own an Amazon Echo device and like to shop online, this could make it easier to add items to your cart without saying commands out loud. Texting might work better if you are in a quiet household or prefer typing.

stories.title: Amazon will let you text Alexa your shopping list
stories.simple_summary: Amazon's shopping assistant Alexa now accepts text messages instead of only voice commands. You can type a description of what you want to buy, or even send a photo, and Alexa will find matching products.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Amazon frequently and own an Alexa device, this adds a convenient new way to shop. You might prefer texting over voice commands, especially if you live in a noisy home or are in public.

stories.title: Global tech stocks plunge amid AI slowdown fears - live updates
stories.simple_summary: Stocks of big technology companies dropped significantly. This happened because investors are worried that AI growth might be slowing down.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own tech stocks in a retirement account or investment portfolio, your holdings lost value. If you don't own tech stocks, this doesn't directly affect you, though overall market changes can matter to your savings and investments.
